description: Observe Medical ASA develops and commercialize medical technology products for patients, healthcare professionals, and hospitals in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The company offers UnoMeter portfolio comprising Unometer, Safeti Plus, Unometer 500, and UnoMeter AbdoPressure products used for manual urine output measurement and for measuring intra-abdominal pressure. It also provides Sippi, a digital and automated urine measurement system for urine monitoring and biofilm control. Observe Medical ASA was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.
